children: Uxin reported unaudited Q2 revenue of RMB1.15B, gross margin of -0.7%, and net loss of RMB178.4M. It expects Q3 revenue of RMB1.16B–RMB1.19B, retail units of 20,500–21,000, and gross margin above 6%.
